text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus wasn't feeling well, so I had her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Forgive me.
I swear I will make a full comeback...

text_block_list.name: Evil Syndicate
text_block_list.text:
Gyaah! Gyaah!
The greengrocer, the fishmonger, the dry cleaner!
Wreck 'em all, wreck 'em! Gya-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What are you guys doing?!
Are you trying to destroy the town?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What are you spacing out for, Justice Biko!
The city is in grave danger at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Kawakami-senpai! A-Alright! Then first—

text_block_list.name: Biko & Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
—Let's evacuate the residents!
—We shall annihilate the enemy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? If we don't let everyone escape,
the damage will only spread!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: If we clean it up quickly, no harm will come of it! At this rate, we won't have any room to escape!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No, evacuating the residents comes first!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Peace is something earned by defeating your enemies!

text_block_list.name: Biko & Kawakami
text_block_list.text: Mmh! If that's how it is—

text_block_list.name: Biko & Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
—Blow 'em away while letting everyone escape!
—Beat 'em down while letting everyone escape!

text_block_list.name: Evil Syndicate
text_block_list.text:
Guh-geeehh!?
What kind of power is this!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"My fists are meant to protect everyone and defeat the enemy!
Nothing is impossible for a hero!"

text_block_list.name: Evil Syndicate
text_block_list.text:
Grrr...! What a reckless bunch!
I'm going all out against you guys too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The lover of peace and curry, emissary of justice, Justice Biko is your opponent!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Take a taste of this burning iron hammerーー!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~! That felt so refreshing!
That was the best dream ever!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Justice Punch!
Justice Kiiick! Hehehe!

After getting some pleasant rest,
Biko Pegasus seems to have regained her top form!
